title: HB1133 (2026 Regular): remove an enhanced permit as a condition of carrying a concealed pistol while on the campus of a public institution of higher education.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2026-01-25; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/297155.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 297155, BillId 26800))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2026-01-25; no passage vote on record. Struck in both sections: "holding an enhanced permit, a restricted enhanced permit, or a reciprocal permit in accordance with chapter 23-7,". Clause (1) quoted without its trailing items (stun gun, mace) which are unchanged.

operative_text:
Section 1 (SDCL 13-39A-43): Except as otherwise provided in § 13-39A-44, neither the South Dakota Board of Technical Education nor any institution under the control of the board may restrict or limit the lawful carrying, possession, storage, or transportation of: (1) A concealed pistol, as defined in § 22-1-2, and compatible ammunition, by any individual within the boundaries of the institution, or while in any building or structure owned or leased by the board or the institution;
Section 2 (SDCL 13-53-56): Except as otherwise provided in § 13-53-57, neither the Board of Regents nor any institution under the control of the board may restrict or limit the lawful carrying, possession, storage, or transportation of: (1) A concealed pistol, as defined in § 22-1-2, and compatible ammunition, by any individual within the boundaries of the institution, or while in any building or structure owned or leased by the board or the institution;
